description: Lua 5.2 language support for the Infinity Engine Enhanced Edition games: syntax diagnostics for .lua files and the Lua embedded in .menu files.
command.validateDocument.title: Validate Current File
configuration.title: IE Lua
configuration.validate.mode.description: Controls when Lua files and the Lua in `.menu` files are validated. Run **IE Lua: Validate Current File** to validate on demand in any mode.
configuration.validate.mode.manual: Validate only when **IE Lua: Validate Current File** is run.
configuration.validate.mode.save: Validate when a file is saved.
configuration.validate.mode.type: Validate while typing, after `#ieLua.validate.debounce#` milliseconds without changes.
configuration.validate.mode.saveAndType: Validate while typing and when a file is saved.
configuration.validate.debounce.descript: Delay in milliseconds after the last change before validating, when `#ieLua.validate.mode#` is `type` or `saveAndType`.
semanticTokenModifiers.global.descriptio: A global variable (a field of the global environment), as opposed to a local.
